name: duplicate-install-warning-preserved
body: Distributing `implementation-phase-reviewer` must not weaken `apg init`'s duplicate-install warning: when a repo's `.opencode/` holds a file that duplicates the installed suite — now including `implementation-phase-reviewer.md` — `apg init` still prints the loud warning listing it and still deletes nothing. The upgrade guide (`APG_UPGRADE_DOC`) documents the manual removal of the now-duplicated local reviewer. Suppressing the warning for this file, or auto-deleting it, is a violation. Satisfaction is assessed by review.
